checkpoints.title: Halt check first in every workflow job
contracts: every job with steps in .github/workflows and the init --gates templates starts with the halt check: if vars.AAYUDHA_HALT != '', a script that fails
instrumentation: the halt step prints ::error:: with the halt reason
checkpoints.rollback: revert the PR; the workflows run unchecked again

checkpoints.title: The init --gates merge-gate template golden
contracts: the rendered merge gate's inspect and pack jobs start with the halt check
